description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for uploading files via POST requests, including handling raw bytes and UploadFile objects.

methods.name: create_file(file: bytes = File(description="A file read as bytes"))
methods.description: Handles POST request at /files/ to accept a file as bytes and returns its size.

methods.name: create_upload_file( file: UploadFile = File(description="A file read as UploadFile"), )
methods.description: Handles POST request at /uploadfile/ to accept a file as UploadFile and returns filename.
